kabeli-transmission-line-compensation-ar.conditions_add: The project agreement of 27 June 2011 required the Nepal Electricity Authority to carry out the transmission line and distribution works in accordance with the environmental management plan, the resettlement action plan and the social management framework, and to ensure that no action was taken that would prevent or interfere with carrying them out (World Bank, Project Agreement for Credit 4932-NP and Grant H676-NP, Schedule, Section I.D). The resettlement action plan of December 2010 was defined in the financing agreement as setting out the compensation, physical relocation and assistance for people displaced by the project. The same schedule required the utility to keep a Kabeli Project Unit for the whole of implementation, headed by a project manager and staffed with people whose experience, qualifications and terms of reference had to satisfy the Association at all times (Section I.A).

narayanghat-mugling-road-structures.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 11 July 2013 required Nepal to carry out the safeguards instruments in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Association, and, where any part of the road works displaced people, to ensure that "no displacement shall occur before necessary resettlement measures consistent with the resettlement action plan applicable to such activity have been executed" (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 5273-NP and Grant H863-NP, Schedule 2, Section I.C). The same section required every works contract to oblige the contractor and any sub-contractor to comply with the environmental and social management framework, the environmental management plan, the resettlement action plan and the vulnerable community development plan, and barred the government from amending, suspending or waiving any of those plans without the Association's prior written concurrence.

The same paragraph required the ministry to keep the project executing unit staffed until the project was finished with named specialists, among them a social and resettlement specialist, and to maintain a project directory committee that met at least every four months and sent its minutes to the Bank.

manila-sewerage-site-clearances-san-mate.conditions_add: The project agreement of 22 July 2005 required Manila Water Company to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental management plan, the resettlement action plans and the land acquisition, resettlement and rehabilitation policy framework in a manner satisfactory to the Bank, to send any proposed change to those documents to the Bank for prior approval, and from 30 June 2006 to have an independent agency audit compliance with them each year (World Bank, Project Agreement for Loan 7311-PH, Schedule 2, paragraph 3). For one named site the agreement set a condition on the works themselves: the company could not start building the sewage treatment plant at Tapayan unless the people displaced by the dike and pond works there "have been compensated and rehabilitated in accordance with a resettlement action plan, satisfactory to the Bank" (Schedule 2, paragraph 5(a)). The same paragraph allowed the company, from 1 January 2008, to start building on an alternative technical design approved by the Bank, but only after taking "all measures necessary to ensure that all Displaced Persons have been resettled and compensated" under a resettlement action plan satisfactory to the Bank (paragraph 5(b)). The Bank lent the money to Land Bank of the Philippines "only on condition that" the Republic of the Philippines guarantee the borrower's obligations, and the Republic also undertook to take all actions needed, through the Department of Public Works and Highways, to carry out that resettlement action plan (Guarantee Agreement for Loan 7311-PH, Preamble and Section 3.02).

why.repay: only on condition that" the Republic of the Philippines guarantee the borrower's obligations

philippines-irrigation-canal-easement-re.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 7 August 2009 required the Philippines to implement the project in accordance with the environmental management plans, the land acquisition and resettlement policy framework and the indigenous peoples planning framework, not to amend or waive any provision of them without the Bank's prior approval, and to allocate enough staff and resources to comply (World Bank, Loan Agreement for Loan 7709-PH, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2). Wherever the works would displace people, the agreement required the government to prepare a resettlement action plan under that framework, give it to the Bank for approval, and then implement the approved plan in a manner satisfactory to the Bank (Section I.A.4). The agreement also required the government to maintain an inter-agency steering committee, a project management office and an environmental and watershed management section inside the National Irrigation Administration's central office to monitor safeguards compliance, all with staffing and terms of reference acceptable to the Bank (Section I.A.1).

rodriguez-ecotourism-site-397-families-r.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 26 January 2004 required the borrower, through the Municipal Development Fund Office, to obtain in each sub-project agreement with a local government the right to require that local government to carry out the environmental and social safeguards framework in a manner satisfactory to the Bank, including, whenever the framework required it, to prepare and implement an environmental management plan and a resettlement action plan (World Bank, Loan Agreement L7205-PH, Schedule 4, paragraph 4(e)). The same paragraph required that the money be used exclusively for the sub-project it was lent for, and that the fund office be able to suspend or terminate a local government's right to use the proceeds if it failed to perform its obligations (Schedule 4, paragraph 4(d) and (i)). The additional loan agreement of 12 May 2011 repeated the requirement that the project, including sub-projects, be implemented in accordance with the environmental and social safeguards framework (Loan Agreement for Loan 8035-PH, Schedule 2, Section I.D).

raciborz-polder-nieboczowy-village-remov.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 11 May 2007 required Poland, through the three water management authorities named in it, to carry out the resettlement and rehabilitation plan of August 2005 and the resettlement policy framework "with due diligence and efficiency and at all times provide the funds necessary therefore", to monitor and evaluate that work, and to keep the Bank informed of progress (World Bank, Loan Agreement L7436-PL, Schedule 5, Section B.3). The agreement defined that plan as the measures needed to ensure displaced people were consulted, offered choices among feasible resettlement alternatives, and given prompt and effective compensation at full replacement cost for lost assets. Resettlement costs, including land acquisition and the replacement value of buildings, were an eligible use of the loan proceeds, and the agreement required an independent panel of experts on polder safety, appointed by 31 December 2007 on terms satisfactory to the Bank (Schedule 5, Section B.4).

kigali-gasabo-electricity-land-retrospec.conditions_add: The credit agreement of 23 February 2005 required Rwanda, and required it to make Electrogaz ensure, that the project was implemented in accordance with the environmental assessment, including the environmental and social management framework and the resettlement policy framework of October 2004, which the agreement describes as agreed with the Association for the resettlement and compensation of people affected by potential changes in land use under the project (World Bank, Credit Agreement C4032-RW, Schedule 4, Section C). Neither the government nor the utility could amend or waive any provision of those documents if, in the Association's opinion, that would materially or adversely affect project implementation. The matching project agreement carried the same requirement for Parts A, B.1-2 and C.1 of the project and added that, to that end, Electrogaz had to recruit an environmental and social advisor whose qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfied the Association.

rwanda-hillside-irrigation-relocation-de.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 8 February 2010 required Rwanda to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental and social management framework, any environmental management plans, the small dam guidelines, any dam safety plans, the resettlement policy framework, any resettlement action plans and the pest management plan, and not to amend, abrogate or waive any of them without the Association's agreement (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 4674-RW, Schedule 2, Section I.D.1). Where those frameworks called for it, the agreement required that a resettlement action plan, environmental management plan or dam safety plan be prepared to the Association's satisfaction and submitted for its review and approval, then adopted and disclosed locally, "prior to implementation" of the sub-project concerned (Section I.D.2). The additional financing agreement of 30 December 2013 repeated these requirements and added a compensation note, defined as listing the land affected, the crops lost, the budget for compensation, a grievance mechanism, the people to be compensated and a certificate of compensation (Financing Agreement for Credit 5360-RW, Schedule 2, Section I.D).

tuz-golu-gas-storage-informal-households.conditions_add: The loan agreement of 2 October 2014 required BOTAS to implement the environmental management plan and the land acquisition plan of February 2013, and, "prior to commencing any works under the Project that requires land to be acquired under the LAP, implement the provisions of the LAP in a manner satisfactory to the Bank" (World Bank, Loan Agreement for Loan 8349-TR, Schedule 2, Section I.A.3). The same section barred the company, except on land covered by that plan, from any involuntary taking of land causing relocation, loss of shelter, loss of assets or loss of a means of livelihood, and required it to keep its project management team staffed and funded to the Bank's satisfaction and, by 31 May 2015, to put to the energy regulator a proposal for setting storage tariffs including an acceptable rate of return on the regulated asset base. The Bank lent to BOTAS against a guarantee in which the Republic of Turkey "unconditionally guarantees, as primary obligor and not as surety merely" every loan payment (Guarantee Agreement for Loan 8349-TR, Section 2.01).

zanzibar-drainage-deaths-compensation.conditions_add: The project agreement of August 2016, which covers both the original Credit 4861-TZ and the additional Credit 5843-TZ, required the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar as implementing entity to carry out the project in accordance with the safeguard documents, and barred any activity needing a resettlement action plan from being implemented until the plan had been prepared, disclosed and approved by the Association, until all measures the plan required beforehand had been taken "including, without limitation to the above, providing funds for resettlement compensation when and if required under a RAP", and until the Association had confirmed the activity could start (World Bank, Project Agreement for Credit 5843-TZ and Credit 4861-TZ, Schedule, Section I.C.2(b)). The matching financing agreement defines the compensation owed as covering land taken, compulsory relocation or loss of shelter, lost assets, lost income or means of livelihood, and restricted access to parks and protected areas, and no safeguard document could be amended or waived without the Association's prior written approval. These are the terms in force from August 2016: the original financing agreement for Credit 4861-TZ, which that agreement dates 6 April 2011, has not been published, and the August 2016 terms therefore came in after the first of the five deaths, the drowning of 3 April 2016, and before the two deaths of 8 November 2019 and the two of 22 March 2020.

why.safeguard: providing funds for resettlement compensation when and if required under a RAP

rwanda-electricity-access-rukarara-reloc.conditions_add: The only agreement the Bank publishes for this project is an amended and restated project agreement of 2016 for Credits 4651-RW and 5193-RW, made seven years after the project was approved and in connection with an amended and restated financing agreement of 6 March 2013 that is itself unpublished. It required the Energy Utility Corporation to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental and social management framework and the resettlement policy framework, and not to amend, abrogate or waive either without the Association's agreement (World Bank, Amended and Restated Project Agreement, Schedule, Section I.D.1). Where those frameworks called for it, an environmental management plan or resettlement action plan had to be prepared to the Association's satisfaction, submitted for its review and approval, then adopted and disclosed locally, "prior to implementation" of the activity concerned, and the utility had to report quarterly on compliance and keep at least two environmental and social specialists in post until the project finished (Section I.D.2 to I.D.4). Because the 2009 original is not published and no document gives the date the Rukarara land was taken, what the lender required at the time of the taking cannot be shown from these papers.

pakistan-earthquake-roads-compensation-a.conditions_add: The project agreement of 26 January 2004 with the National Highway Authority required that "all land acquisition required for the purposes of carrying out any works under the Project and activities related to the resettlement and rehabilitation of the PAPs in connection with such works will be completed prior to the carrying out of such works", in accordance with the resettlement policy framework of 30 May 2003 and the relevant resettlement action plans and in a manner satisfactory to the Association and the Bank (World Bank, Project Agreement for Credit 3846-PAK and Loan 7212-PAK, Schedule 2, paragraph 4). The same paragraph required that no land for the project be taken using the emergency provisions of Section 17 of the Land Acquisition Act. Paragraph 5 required the authority to apply the framework and related safeguard policies uniformly to all components of the project, and also to other construction contracts running during the project period on National Highway N-5 and National Highway M-9 that caused involuntary resettlement, "regardless of the source of financing". The earthquake roads were added to the project as a new Part C by the amending agreement of 6 December 2005, which brought in the US$100 million additional loan and defined a Part C environmental assessment framework to be prepared to the satisfaction of the Bank and the Association; that amending agreement made its own effectiveness depend on a separate agreement amending the project agreement with the authority, and that amending agreement is not published.

bukhara-sewer-pump-station-cleared-plot.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 26 November 2009 required Uzbekistan to make the Bukhara and Samarkand water utilities carry out their parts of the project in accordance with their environmental management plans and the resettlement policy framework disclosed in April 2009, and, "prior to the commencement of works for each proposed site", to submit to the Association for approval the design and site and, where the framework required it, the site-specific land acquisition or resettlement plan, together with the proposed works contract, so that the plan's provisions were written into the contract (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 4633-UZ, Schedule 2, Section I.D.2). The project's own resettlement action plan for the Bukhara sewer works, dated 18 May 2012, records that the construction work had already started and that the fence, gate, brick store and chicken shelter on the occupied plot had already been dismantled by the contractor. The additional financing agreement of May 2016 went further, four years after that: before any works under its investment parts, the utilities had to prepare and disclose the resettlement plan and then carry out the works in accordance with it, "including full payment of compensation and the provision of relocation assistance to Displaced Persons prior to their displacement", and the government had to maintain a socially inclusive grievance mechanism satisfactory to the Association (Financing Agreement for Credits 5698-UZ and 5699-UZ, Schedule 2, Section I.D as amended).

ferghana-valley-drainage-land-taken-with.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 9 February 2010 required Uzbekistan to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental assessment, the environmental management plan, the resettlement policy framework and the resettlement action plan, and not to amend, suspend, abrogate, repeal or waive any provision of them without the Association's prior written approval (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 4648-UZ, Schedule 2, Section I.C.1). For the drainage works, and "prior to the commencement of works for each proposed site", the agreement required the government to submit to the Association for approval the proposed design and site and, where the framework or plan required it, the site-specific land acquisition or resettlement plan, and the proposed works contract, so that the plan's provisions were included in the contract (Section I.C.2). The agreement defines the resettlement action plan as the one prepared for 37 farms, and cash compensation was a category of spending the credit itself financed.

why.safeguard: prior to the commencement of works for each proposed site", the agreement required the government to submit to the Association for approval the proposed design and site and, where the framework or plan required it, the site-specific land acquisition or resettlement plan

ferghana-valley-drainage-land-taken-with.searched: Read the conformed financing agreement for Credit 4648-UZ; the safeguards covenants and the before-works approval requirement are in Schedule 2, Section I.C, and the resettlement action plan named in the definitions covers 37 farms.

hopewell-road-land-taken-st-vincent.conditions_add: The financing agreement of 22 February 2011 required Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, before carrying out any rehabilitation or reconstruction works, to prepare, adopt and disclose an environmental management framework satisfactory to the Association and then to keep to it, to prepare any environmental management plan the Association required before works began, and to submit it for approval, disclose it locally and implement it (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 4852-VC, Schedule 2, Section I.D). The agreement also required a programme management unit inside the finance ministry, staffed to the Association's satisfaction, to handle environmental safeguard compliance among its duties. That safeguards section covers environmental instruments only: the words resettlement, land acquisition and displaced persons appear nowhere in the agreement, and the Bank's completion report records that the involuntary resettlement policy was triggered only by a restructuring on 26 August 2013, after the Hopewell road works were found to be encroaching on two private properties.

why.safeguard: to prepare, adopt and disclose an environmental management framework satisfactory to the Association and then to keep to it
why.admin: required a programme management unit inside the finance ministry, staffed to the Association's satisfaction

hopewell-road-land-taken-st-vincent.searched: Read the whole of Schedule 2 of the conformed financing agreement for Credit 4852-VC: section D of the implementation arrangements is headed Environmental Safeguards and the agreement contains no resettlement or land acquisition covenant. The Bank's document record for this project holds no amended agreement from the August 2013 restructuring that triggered the resettlement policy.

hade-shala-neighbourhood-mine-resettleme.conditions_add: The financing agreement of May 2013 for the project's second additional financing made the Ministry of Environment and Spatial Planning responsible for carrying out the resettlement action plan for the Shala neighbourhood of Hade village, which the agreement dates December 2011 and describes as prepared for the ministry with financing from a different Bank operation, and required Kosovo to ensure that the resettlement "is undertaken in accordance with the provisions and procedures contained in the RAP" and that all relevant information was given to affected and potentially affected people in a timely and adequate way (World Bank, Financing Agreement for Credit 5240-XK, Schedule 2, Section I.D.4). The plan could not be amended, suspended, terminated or waived without the Association's prior written approval. The same section barred any final decision on the use of the reclaimed land, and any sale, transfer or lease of it, until a land use plan satisfactory to the Association had been drawn up in a participatory manner, and the matching project agreement put the same bar on the Kosovo Energy Corporation. The covenant dates from 2013: the plan it names was already eighteen months old, the resettlement was completed in July 2016, and the project's earlier financing agreements of 2006 and 2007 name no Shala resettlement plan at all.

why.safeguard: is undertaken in accordance with the provisions and procedures contained in the RAP
why.admin: barred any final decision on the use of the reclaimed land, and any sale, transfer or lease of it, until a land use plan satisfactory to the Association had been drawn up in a participatory manner

hade-shala-neighbourhood-mine-resettleme.searched: Read the conformed financing agreements for Grant H234-XK of 2006, Grant H319-XK of 2007 and Credit 5240-XK of 2013 with its project agreement. The Shala neighbourhood resettlement plan is named only in the 2013 agreement, which also names the resettlement policy framework approved on 6 July 2011; the words Shala and Hade do not appear in the 2006 or 2007 agreements or in the 2013 project agreement. The 2013 cover date is handwritten and partly illegible, giving May 2013; the Bank's record dates it 15 May 2013. The completion report dates the final resettlement completion report to July 2016.

west-bank-substation-land-taking-eump.conditions_add: The trust fund grant agreement of 30 June 2008 required the recipient, the Palestine Liberation Organization acting for the benefit of the Palestinian Authority, to cause the Palestinian Authority to carry out the project in accordance with the environmental impact assessment, the environmental management plan and the resettlement policy framework, "including the requirement therein to prepare a site-specific Resettlement Action Plan under Part 1 of the Project, in a manner satisfactory to the Administrator, prior to the commencement of works on the respective site" (World Bank, Trust Fund Grant Agreement TF092336, Schedule 2, Section I.E.1). Part 1 was the supply and installation of the four bulk 161 kV substations. The same schedule set financial covenants on the distribution companies: the Jerusalem, Hebron and northern companies had to break even by fiscal year 2009, the southern company by 2010 and the Gaza company by 2011; the Jerusalem company could not incur debt unless a reasonable forecast of its internal funds over the term of the debt was at least 1.5 times its estimated debt service, and it had to keep a self-financing ratio of at least 15 per cent of the annual average of its capital spending; and every company's receivables had to fall to three months of average electricity billing by fiscal year 2012 (Section I.A.4). The Bank's completion report records that those financial covenants were eliminated in a level-one restructuring in September 2013. These are the World Bank's terms; the European Investment Bank, which paid for the substations themselves, is a second lender on this case whose terms are not settled.

why.safeguard: including the requirement therein to prepare a site-specific Resettlement Action Plan under Part 1 of the Project, in a manner satisfactory to the Administrator, prior to the commencement of works on the respective site
why.fincov: the Jerusalem company could not incur debt unless a reasonable forecast of its internal funds over the term of the debt was at least 1.5 times its estimated debt service

sao-gabriel-cable-station-urban-farmers.ct_note: No financing agreement for this grant has been published. The published reports describe the resettlement policy framework disclosed on 23 November 2010, the abbreviated resettlement plan, and the US$13,005 the telecom company paid to seven people, but none of them says the grant money depended on any of it.

kasumbalesa-market-traders-moved.conditions_add: The Bank's completion report records one requirement of the original credit agreement for this project: the National Road Fund Agency prepared a plan for its operations after the project "as required under Section 3.3 of the Development Credit Agreement" (World Bank, Implementation Completion and Results Report, 27 April 2015, paragraph 68). The resettlement policy framework for the project was disclosed in October 2003 and the abbreviated resettlement plan for the Kasumbalesa border post in July 2006, both before the only loan agreement the Bank publishes for this project: the additional financing agreement of 12 April 2007, which required that, before civil works involving resettlement or land taking, Zambia "prepare and implement appropriate resettlement plans for compensation, resettlement and rehabilitation of Displaced Persons, in accordance with the Resettlement Policy Framework" (Financing Agreement, Credit 3866-1 ZA, Schedule 4, Section I.B.2). That agreement postdates the move of the market traders, so it is not carried here as a term that governed it.
kasumbalesa-market-traders-moved.ct_note: The credit agreement that paid for the border post works, signed in 2004, has not been published. The Bank's document record for the project holds 34 documents, among them the 2004 appraisal document, the completion report and the 2007 additional financing agreement, but not the original development credit agreement for Credit 3866-ZA, and the Bank's document system holds nothing under that credit number. What that agreement required is known only from the single section the completion report cites.

why.admin: as required under Section 3.3 of the Development Credit Agreement
why.exhaust: the only loan agreement the Bank publishes for this project: the additional financing agreement of 12 April 2007

kitwe-mufuchani-bridge-relocation.conditions_add: The Bank's completion report for the second phase says the environmental assessment and resettlement action plans for the Mufuchani bridge "were already reviewed and accepted by the World Bank during RRMP I implementation", that is under the first phase of the road programme, and that 57 houses, two churches and a 1.5 km access road were built in Kitwe for the people moved, with water, sewerage and electricity connections (World Bank, Implementation Completion and Results Report, 26 October 2016, paragraph 36). The first phase financed the design and supervision of the Mufuchani resettlement plan and the supervision of the resettlement works, and its completion report records a resettlement plan of US$3.5 million prepared and implemented for 333 people from 57 households affected by the bridge. The first-phase additional financing agreement of 12 April 2007 required that, before any civil works involving resettlement or land taking, Zambia "prepare and implement appropriate resettlement plans for compensation, resettlement and rehabilitation of Displaced Persons, in accordance with the Resettlement Policy Framework"; the resettlement plan for the Mufuchani bridge was disclosed in August 2007, four months after it (Financing Agreement, Credit 3866-1 ZA, Schedule 4, Section I.B.2, and the first phase's completion report, Table 4 and paragraph 44).
kitwe-mufuchani-bridge-relocation.ct_note: The financing agreement for the credit that built the bridge has not been published. The Bank's completion report lists a financing agreement of 25 November 2009 for Credit 4654-ZA as a supporting document, but the Bank's record for this project holds 28 documents and no agreement among them, and the Bank's document system holds nothing under that credit number or the project name. The requirement quoted here is from the first phase's agreement, under which the bridge's resettlement plan was prepared, accepted and supervised.

why.safeguard: prepare and implement appropriate resettlement plans for compensation, resettlement and rehabilitation of Displaced Persons, in accordance with the Resettlement Policy Framework
why.exhaust: were already reviewed and accepted by the World Bank during RRMP I implementation
